rationale: Keep Biddeford Lincoln Garage & RiverWalk as a standalone operational infrastructure asset and reject the earlier conceptual-platform merge. Add the current Amber marketing name and legal project-company alias, record Amber's officially disclosed 100% equity ownership, remove the placeholder ownership vehicle, improve the location and description, and make Amber's current asset case study the primary citation.

evidence.purpose: Current official Amber evidence that the standalone Biddeford asset is operational, 100% owned, located in Maine and financially closed in August 2020.
Government evidence identifying Biddeford RiverWalk Community 1, LLC as the project company with financing and operating responsibility under the 25-year arrangement.
Audited municipal evidence confirming the project company and continuing availability-payment arrangement through fiscal 2046.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Biddeford Lincoln Garage & RiverWalk is an operational downtown parking and civic-infrastructure public-private partnership in Biddeford, Maine. The project comprises a 640-space parking garage, downtown parking operations, utility and public-realm improvements, and funding for a portion of the City's RiverWalk. Biddeford RiverWalk Community 1, LLC finances and operates the parking system under a 25-year arrangement supported by parking revenues and municipal availability payments. Amber Infrastructure's current project case study reports 100% equity ownership and an August 2020 financial close.
